unreleased: Add a forms module (app/modules/forms) for other modules to build on: forms with questions of seven types (checkbox, radio, text, number, date, time, date and time), questions shown only when earlier answers say so (several conditions, chaining through hidden questions), validation of the answers on the server with error codes (the regular expression of a text question is run with a time limit, and one that backtracks catastrophically is refused when the form is saved), answers stored as a snapshot of the questions as they were worded when answered, and, for administrators, browsing the answers and a basic summary per question (counts and shares of the options, minimum / maximum / average / median of numbers, earliest and latest dates). The questions of a form are replaced as a whole list, in order; a form that still has answers cannot be deleted

The event calendar module now builds on articles: an event is just a date (or a run of days, with optional times, a title and a description of up to 128 characters) belonging to exactly one article, an article can have several. The wall (/dashboard) is made of articles - the one with the nearest upcoming date, the pinned ones and the last five past ones - the calendar, archive and search follow the article's visibility (archived articles stay findable), and search also looks through the article text ignoring diacritics. GET /by-article/{id} lists an article's dates. Events no longer have their own page, slug, image, status or pinned flag, and image upload moved to the articles module. The database table is recreated: existing events are NOT carried over

Add an articles module (app/modules/articles): articles with a title, perex, sanitized HTML content, image, status (draft / published / archived), optional display window, a pinned flag and a type, plus dynamic article types with frame and background colours for the light and dark theme. Public listing, search ignoring case and diacritics over title, perex and full text (archived articles included, drafts never), detail by slug, and administrator-only management with image upload; a type in use is deleted only with a replacement type

The shared HTML sanitizer now also keeps tables, text alignment, horizontal rules, code blocks and YouTube / Vimeo video embeds; frames from any other address, and anything that could run script, are still removed on every save

A module can declare the modules it requires (`ModuleManifest.requires`); enabling one without them now logs a warning at startup, naming both, instead of failing later in some request. The warning never stops the application

Contact-form module: GET /api/modules/kontaktni_formular/info serves a per-language page heading, introduction and note (the new `page` block of backend/modules/kontaktni_formular.json) plus public contact details - address, GitHub and LinkedIn links from CONTACT_ADDRESS / CONTACT_GITHUB_URL / CONTACT_LINKEDIN_URL in .env, and the delivery address only when `show_email` is on. Nothing is shown until it is configured

Add a CRM module (app/modules/crm), for administrators only: partners with contact and company details, their tasks (status, price, dates), and invoice PDFs uploaded against a task - checked to really be PDFs and capped at 10 MB, stored privately under uploads/crm/ and served only to administrators through an authenticated download

Events in the event calendar module can now only be managed by this application's administrators (the is_admin flag on the local user account) - the auth service's user role no longer grants it, since that role applies to every application
Add is_admin flag to the local user account, with a require_admin dependency for gating admin-only routes

Add an event calendar module (app/modules/event_calendar): events with their own pages, display windows, pinning and thumbnails; public endpoints for the upcoming list (paged by 10), a month view, a year/month archive, a home-page dashboard and search; editor endpoints with sanitized WYSIWYG content and image upload, with editors chosen by auth-service role or an application's own check
Add a shared HTML sanitizer (app/services/sanitize.py) for content written in the WYSIWYG editor - keeps headings 1-5, text color, font and size, and strips anything executable

The contact form's confirmation email is now sent in the language the form was submitted in: subject and body templates per language, an on/off switch and a default language (used when the requested one has no template) live in the git-tracked backend/modules/kontaktni_formular.json instead of .env

Feature modules are now switched on in backend/modules.json (tracked in git, same shape as the frontend's public/modules.json) instead of ENABLED_MODULES in .env, so each application branch carries its own module selection and switching branches no longer keeps the previous branch's modules

The Stripe payment gate module now records what the payer agreed to before paying (terms and conditions, and for digital content the waiver of the 14-day withdrawal right), with a timestamp, as evidence stored with the payment
Store the notifications module's data in a module_notifications table (instead of notifications), so the module can coexist with an application's own notifications table

Add a Stripe payment gate module (app/modules/stripe_payment_gate): starts payments through Stripe Checkout for server-side-priced "payment purposes" that each application registers, and confirms them via a signature-verified webhook (with a direct Stripe re-check as fallback), running the purpose's own post-payment hook exactly once

Add a notifications module (app/modules/notifications): a generic, per-user in-app notification list (GET /api/modules/notifications, mark one or all as read) that any application can create notifications into via a plain create_notification() call, without this module needing to know anything about that application's own data
Add a contact-form module (app/modules/kontaktni_formular): sends the message to CONTACT_MAIL plus a confirmation copy to the sender, signed with the sender's real name when they're signed in

Add a pluggable feature-module system: self-contained modules under app/modules/ are auto-discovered and toggled on/off per application via ENABLED_MODULES, with no code changes to shared routing or migrations
Add GET /api/public/release-news endpoint, exposing release_news.json for the frontend's release news page

changes: FastAPI backend with an async Postgres stack (SQLAlchemy + asyncpg), Alembic migrations, time-rotating logging, and a parametrizable email service
Backend-for-frontend proxy to the shared auth.withfbraun.com identity service: register, login, refresh, logout, local RS256 JWT verification, Google OAuth support
Custom in-app consent flow (group-info, grant/reject) instead of the auth service's hosted consent page
Local account resource (GET/PATCH /api/account/me) kept strictly separate from the auth-service-proxied profile endpoints
Profile updates and configurable per-application user attributes via the group-attributes endpoints
Public /api/public/version endpoint for build and deployment health checks
